variants.name: notched ditch-cutter
variants.forms: Two unequal shoulder slate lips separated by a real notch, plus three narrow raised pale rake scars on the left forelimb.

variants.name: ditch-cutter mate
variants.forms: One offset rear slate attached to the original back, plus two short pale rake scars on the right forelimb. The unsupported decorative corner was removed after actual contact validation.

bounds: Same low broad original anatomy; small additions remain within the source silhouette width, below +0.10 root units above dorsal height.
honesty: Wear/slate is visual anatomy, not added gameplay armor. Weapons and cap are never baked into the body. Native viewed gallery required.
